content:
anya: follow-up to the "RFC: transport/runtime boundary" thread. we need a concise, cross-lang pattern so py/ts/go behave the same for retries + pagination without leaking runtime internals.

matt: agree. we've been drifting because each lang adds tiny flags. propose a tiny capability descriptor that transports return and core SDKs negotiate against.

jin: runtime handshake or compile-time?

anya: runtime handshake. transport returns capabilities like streaming/paged/resumeTokenType/idempotency/prefetchHints. SDK core picks adapter.

samir: concrete issues: python used structured resume tokens (dict), ts used opaque base64 string, go supported both. caused confusing resume failures.

laura: also standardize retry shape. single RetryPolicy object with fields attempts, base_ms, max_ms, retry_on list. share shape across langs.

matt: sketch: capabilities = { streaming: true, paged: true, resumeTokens: "opaque"|"structured"|"none", prefetch: {mode:"auto"|"manual", maxPages:2} }
client.call(method, args, options={ retries:{attempts:3, base_ms:200}, preferStreaming:true })

anya: fallback: if transport lacks streaming, SDK uses paged->stream adapter. transports should advertise fallbacks.

jin: user-facing API must be simple; expose options bag with sensible defaults, advanced knobs hidden.

laura: reconcile defaults: global client defaults < route-level overrides < per-call options. doc those.

samir: rollout plan: opt-in capability negotiation in minor SDK releases behind a feature flag; add transport-conformance tests for interop.

anya: interop tests: harness scenarios (stream->paged fallback, resume after transient, prefetch under load). add to CI gating.

matt: pagination surface: unify events from transport: {type:"page", items:[..]}, {type:"resume", token:"v1:..."}, map to generator/iterator in py/ts/go. include schema_version in token payload.

laura: telemetry: emit events when fallbacks happen and when retries exhaust. Optimize can use signals to recommend tuning.

ops-bot: "deploy-bot: scheduling canary rollout for transport-v2 next week; feature-flag 'transport-v2' enabled per region."

anya: action items:
- matt: draft canonical RetryPolicy + capability descriptor this week
- jin: propose iterator mapping for py/ts/go (PR)
- samir: add transport-conformance checklist to eng-tests
- laura: write migration guide + telemetry plan

matt: i'll write a short RFC addendum with shapes and checklist. if no objections by Fri we land opt-in patch.

anya: thanks. ping me for the interop harness pairing. :thumbsup:
